question: In each league, considering all seasons, which single team has the fewest total match wins based on comparing home and away goals, including teams with zero wins, ensuring that if multiple teams tie for the fewest wins, only one team is returned for each league?
sql:
-- Final query with proper integer types
WITH team_matches AS (
    SELECT 
        m.league_id,
        m.home_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
        CAST(CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INTEGER) AS home_wins,
        CAST(0 AS INTEGER) AS away_wins
    FROM Match m
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        m.league_id,
        m.away_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
        CAST(0 AS INTEGER) AS home_wins,
        CAST(CASE WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INTEGER) AS away_wins
    FROM Match m
),
team_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        league_id,
        team_api_id,
        SUM(home_wins + away_wins) AS total_wins
    FROM team_matches
    GROUP BY league_id, team_api_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        league_id,
        team_api_id,
        total_wins,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY league_id ORDER BY total_wins ASC, team_api_id ASC) AS rn
    FROM team_wins
)
SELECT 
    l.name AS league_name,
    t.team_long_name AS team_name,
    r.total_wins
FROM ranked r
JOIN League l ON r.league_id = l.id
JOIN Team t ON r.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE r.rn = 1
ORDER BY l.name

{"sql": "-- Step 1: Build a CTE that counts wins for each team in each league
-- For each match, the home team wins if home_team_goal > away_team_goal
-- For each match, the away team wins if away_team_goal > home_team_goal

WITH team_matches AS (

        m.away_team_api_id AS team_api_id,

    FROM Match m
),

    SELECT 
        league_id,
        team_api_id,
        SUM(home_wins + away_wins) AS total_wins
